en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard featuring a studio-style photograph of two young boys in traditional Chinese clothing standing side by side and holding hands. The boys wear long tunics, loose trousers, cloth shoes, and round caps. The photo is centered with a wide light border. Printed captions run vertically along the left and right margins, with a title at the bottom and a handwritten number in pencil in the lower right.
